_doc: FROZEN calibration corpus for the recognition schema redesign (docs/design_recognition_schema_redesign_2026-08-20.md §6, consensus PIN 2). Enumerated and committed BEFORE the first prompt iteration; no frame may be added or dropped mid-calibration. Ground truth comes from the bench card's receipted staging (bench5/bench6 logs, archived with the photos in the vault at 03_validation/recognition_corpus_2026-08-20/). Photos live outside git: on the Pi at ~/recognitions/, on the Mac in the vault archive.
_budget_doc: PIN 2: if the prompt cannot clear every gate within 6 evaluated iterations, calibration STOPS and the round returns to the PM — warm-iterating past the budget is the model-polishing drift this guards against.

gates.schema_valid: every included frame parses (parse_recognition_reply) — any parse failure fails the iteration
gates.absent_zero_fp: class=absent: match=false on ALL frames — one match=true fails the iteration (the zero-FP bar)
gates.bottle_identity_honest: class=bottle: identity in [confirmed, unverified] on ALL frames — a mismatch on the true target is a false contradiction and fails the iteration
gates.controller: class=controller: match=true on ALL frames, identity in [confirmed, unverified] on ALL frames, zero mismatch, zero WRONG confirmed (AMENDED 2026-08-20, PM ruling after iteration 1 — see _amendments)
gates.picture_recorded: class=picture: recorded verbatim, NO gate (pixel-starved at 1.2 m; the approach-required exemplar)

_amendments.original_text_retained: class=controller: match=true AND identity=confirmed on ALL frames
_amendments.ruling: PM ruling after iteration 1 (gate corrected, not bar-lawyered): (1) 'xbox controller' is brand-qualified AS A FACT of the frozen target string — the design note mis-CLASSIFIED it as the plain exemplar and the gate inherited the misclassification, not a different standard; (2) the ratified schema's own doctrine says brand-qualified targets at standoff legitimately return unverified — the bottle gate already embodies it; (3) demanding confirmed-3/3 on 60 px of logo-free pixels REWARDS false confidence, the exact direction the zero-wrong-confirmed bar exists to forbid — an un-amended gate would optimize the prompt AGAINST the design's own safety property. Coverage gap patched LIVE, not by corpus surgery: the re-cert sitting adds one fresh invocation with the identity-free target 'game controller' on the staged controller (expectation: match + confirmed) as the true plain-object confirmed-probe.
